- YTXTube music player: a Song / Video switch at the top, as in YouTube Music. Song shows the cover, Video shows the video of the same track in its place, and the music goes on either way.
- A thumb down ("not for me") next to the heart: the song is left out of what plays next, of the queue and of the music home (and kept across restarts), the next song plays, and a second tap takes it back. Signed in, the dislike is sent to YouTube too.
- YTXTube Series and movies is a page of shelves, not a form: a big title, a line under it, a search box, then "Popular series" and "Popular movies" as rows of posters; a tap opens the seasons (or the film's download). The add-on and the size are behind one row. It is in the Library tab (and still in Saved).
- YTXTube queue: no more "Playing next" / "Added to queue" / "Up next" messages. In the music player a queue button (with the count) next to the menu opens the list to play, remove or clear; the track menu has Play next and Add to queue; the video player's queue works the same. Other messages are lifted above the navigation bar (they sat under the bottom of the screen).
- Pulse's old launcher icons (Windows 95, XP, 7, 10, 11) moved from Settings to Extra apps > icon settings ("Pulse's old icons").
- Lyrics editor follows the look (it was always black). Word times: the pass that gives the lyrics on the phone their word times runs once more after this update (a find is taken when three in five of the lines match, it was four in five), and a song with no find is looked up again after a day instead of three.
- YTXTube's picture-in-picture window has a headphones button (play on in the background, audio only, the window closes) next to play / pause and next. The phone's own gear in that window is the system's and cannot be removed.
- Packs ask once the first time they are wanted ("Download it now (5 MB)?", e.g. the gym pictures); a yes downloads by itself, a no leaves the Download button. Packs come from this app's own repository; when GitHub does not answer, jsDelivr is tried (and the other way round).
